---
title: "check-search-shortcut.yml"
---

Blocking check that flags a Quarto site whose search opens on Ctrl/Cmd-F or Ctrl/Cmd-S.
Quarto's `website.search.keyboard-shortcut` (`book.search.keyboard-shortcut` for a book)
defaults to `["f", "/", "s"]`.
Its script listens for `keyup` and never checks a modifier key,
so the keyup that follows Ctrl/Cmd-F (find in page) or Ctrl/Cmd-S (save) opens site search too.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-28) is that every Quarto site keeps only `"/"`.
This implements
[gha#1287](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1287).

```yaml
website:
  search:
    keyboard-shortcut: ["/"]
```

A project directory is flagged when either of these holds:

- it defines a site (a `website:` or `book:` key in a `_quarto*.yml` file)
  and no `_quarto*.yml` file there sets `keyboard-shortcut`,
  so the default applies;
- any `keyboard-shortcut` in the directory lists something other than exactly `"/"`.

Set `search: false` directly under `website:` or `book:` to turn the site search off,
which also turns this check off for that project.
A `search: false` deeper in the file, such as a sidebar's, does not.

## Scope

The check reads the matching config files whole,
because they are small and a missing setting has no line a diff could add.
Files under `_extensions/` are always skipped.
The parser is line-based, so the action needs no YAML package.
It reads an inline list (`["/"]`) or a block list (`- "/"`).

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default           | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ----------------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'_quarto*.yml'`  | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`              | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`            | Fail the workflow when a site opens search on f or s. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`          | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-search-shortcut.yml in your repo.
# Flags a Quarto site whose search opens on Ctrl/Cmd-F or Ctrl/Cmd-S: a
# website: or book: with no keyboard-shortcut, or a keyboard-shortcut that
# lists more than "/". Fix: under website: (or book:) add
#   search:
#     keyboard-shortcut: ["/"]
# Blocking by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check site search shortcut

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-search-shortcut.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '_quarto*.yml'                 # config files to read (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'docs/**'               # skip known-noisy paths
    #   fail: true                            # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
```

See
[`examples/check-search-shortcut.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-search-shortcut.yml)
for the full caller stub.
